dimension_policy: All advanced study dimensions are authored. Public manufacturer sources establish feature families and process distinctions, not exact product replicas or approved tooling limits.

sources.title: Protolabs sheet-metal fabrication capabilities
sources.used: Public family of bent brackets, mounts and more complex formed parts. The hat rail dimensions, foot slots, crown holes and four-bend section are authored.

sources.title: Mate: Solid Models and Dimensioned Drawings
sources.used: Manufacturer example explicitly identifies formed open-end louvers and their tooling. This study uses six authored 30-degree open-ended flaps; it does not copy a catalog louver or model tooling draft and plastic response.

sources.title: Mate: Forming Tools Help Productivity and Efficiency
sources.used: Manufacturer describes formed embosses, dimples, ribs and local stretching/compression. The closed beads and pierced dimples are authored geometric targets with constant normal thickness; stiffness improvement, draw-in and thinning are not calculated.

sources.title: Mate: Use Strengthening Ribs to Add Structural Rigidity
sources.used: Manufacturer distinguishes rolled ribs and beaded embosses. The study models three closed beaded embosses; their dimensions and unvalidated structural intent are authored.

sources.title: Lehmann: Single Forms Deep-Drawn
sources.used: Manufacturer describes single-sheet pans with rounded corners and no seams. This supplies the continuous-tray construction family. The 160 x 120 mm study and 1.2 mm thickness are independent authored choices, not the product's dimensions or material specification.

sources.title: Manor Tool: Deep Drawn Stamping, How to Select an Edge Type
sources.used: Pages 4-5 distinguish drawn parts with untrimmed and trimmed flanges. The study adopts a controlled outer flange as a target shape; its rounded rectangular plan, dimensions and mounting slots are authored. No blank outline or draw process is inferred.
